description:
Hushfacebook v0.5.0 targets Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 (com.facebook.katana), and 577.0.0.50.72 still works.

This release gathers everything since v0.4.0 and brings 51 patches, up from 43. The new ones are Hide the Reels tab dot (no red dot or number on the Reels tab), Hide the Reels tab, Keep the reel speed, Hold a reel for 2x, Default playback quality, Turn off double tap to like, Open Messenger from the top bar and View stories anonymously. Hide the Reels tab dot and Keep the reel speed are on by default, Open Messenger from the top bar goes in with its switch off, and the rest are yours to pick.

The "Suggested for you" groups row is hidden again, Marketplace search results lose their ads, stories and VP9 reels save at full quality, AMOLED cards turn black, and a Messenger patched with the same key works with your Facebook, including Continue as.

Validation: 1327 runtime tests passed locally. All 565 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 51 patches applied to Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72; resource and injected-code checks passed. Every new patch was tried on a phone.

Some reports still need the reporter's details, including WhatsApp import, Xiaomi Gallery sound, Media settings and a missing Reel Download button. Review diagnostic reports for private data before sharing them.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a, Android 11+ bundle of Facebook 580.0.0.51.74, build 475019344, or 577.0.0.50.72, build 474426275. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.

patches.name: AMOLED black theme
patches.description: Makes Facebook's dark mode black instead of dark grey. Turn on dark mode in Facebook first.

patches.name: Block ad telemetry
patches.description: Stops Facebook watching for screenshots of ads and reporting which apps you install for ad attribution.

patches.name: Block background ad prefetch
patches.description: Stops Facebook downloading ads and its ad model in the background. That saves data and battery. The ads don't take up storage either.

patches.name: Block background-return feed refresh
patches.description: Keeps your feed position when you return to Facebook within ten minutes, or for any time away with No time limit on. Pull to refresh and a fresh launch still work.

patches.name: Block promotional notifications
patches.description: Keeps the kinds of notification you pick off your phone, such as trending videos, memories and birthdays. Each kind has its own switch, and they all start off. Messages, friend requests, comments, mentions and login alerts always come through.

patches.name: Clean up Reels
patches.description: Hides the Follow button on reels and the comment and reaction previews under them. Buttons such as Remix, Use template, Add yours and Stars go too, and each part has its own switch.

patches.name: Default comment order
patches.description: Opens comments in the order you choose in Hushfacebook's settings, Most relevant, Newest or All comments, instead of the one Facebook picks. An order you pick in a post's comments stays for that post, and links to a comment still open on it.

patches.name: Default playback quality
patches.description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose in Hushfacebook's settings, such as Data saver or up to 720p, instead of the one Facebook picks as it plays. A quality you pick in a video's own menu still wins for that video.

patches.name: Disable Audience Network
patches.description: Stops Facebook serving ads to other apps. Those apps then show their own ads or none, and rewarded ads can fail.

patches.name: Don't send reel watch history
patches.description: Stops sending Facebook the list of reels you've watched. It's used to rank your Reels feed, and nobody else sees it. Reels you've already watched may come back in the feed.

patches.name: Download any reel
patches.description: Adds a Download button beside every reel. Videos save at the Download quality you set, best by default.

patches.name: Download any story
patches.description: Adds Save to the menu of any story, including stories with music. Videos save at the Download quality you set, best by default.

patches.name: Download any video
patches.description: Adds Download to phone to the menu of videos in the feed and in Watch, below Facebook's own items. Videos save at the Download quality you set, best by default.

patches.name: Hide AI-detected posts
patches.description: Removes feed posts that Facebook's own detection marked as made with AI, and the reels and Watch videos it flagged the same way. A third switch also removes posts their creator labelled as AI. Every switch starts off, so turn them on in Hushfacebook's settings.

patches.name: Hide Menu promotions
patches.description: Hides the Upgrades and Also from Meta sections of Facebook's Menu. Each has its own switch. Settings, Help and support, your shortcuts and the rest of the Menu stay.

patches.name: Hide Meta AI in search
patches.description: Removes the Meta AI answer and the Ask Meta AI prompts Facebook adds to search results, and stops search suggestions from opening Meta AI by themselves. People, groups, pages and posts stay, and the Meta AI button still works.

patches.name: Hide Reels in the feed
patches.description: Removes the rows of reels between posts in the news feed, and the reels Facebook adds where your feed ends. A reel a friend posts stays.

patches.name: Hide Stories tray
patches.description: Removes the row of stories at the top of the news feed, Create story included.

patches.name: Hide affiliate product links
patches.description: Removes the product cards of affiliate shop links from reels, feed posts and the comment sheet. The "Commission eligible" label stays.

patches.name: Hide post prompts
patches.description: Removes the strip Facebook adds to some posts, like "Are you interested in this post?", "Show less", who recently commented, or follow and chat suggestions, with no gap left behind. The post stays.

patches.name: Hide posts by words
patches.description: Hides feed posts whose text has a word or phrase you list, unless it also has one from your keep list. Hushfacebook never sends your words anywhere. The switch starts off, so turn it on and add words in Hushfacebook's settings.

patches.name: Hide reel interest prompts
patches.description: Removes the "Are you interested in this reel?" prompt from reels. The reel plays as usual.

patches.name: Hide sponsored Marketplace listings
patches.description: Removes the ads and boosted listings from Marketplace's feed and search results. The feed's request asks Facebook to leave them out and the requests that fetch only ads don't go out. Ads that come back among search results are taken out before Marketplace shows them. The listings people post stay.

patches.name: Hide sponsored posts
patches.description: Removes sponsored and promoted posts from the news feed, with no gap left behind.

patches.name: Hide sponsored profile posts
patches.description: Removes the ads between the posts on someone's profile or a Page. The profile's own posts stay.

patches.name: Hide sponsored reels
patches.description: Removes ads from Reels and Watch, including product banners over a reel and ads inside a video.

patches.name: Hide sponsored search results
patches.description: Removes the ads from Facebook's search results, the sponsored posts and ad cards between the people, pages and posts you searched for.

patches.name: Hide sponsored stories
patches.description: Removes ad cards from the story viewer, so swiping through stories only shows stories people posted.

patches.name: Hide suggested and promoted posts
patches.description: Removes what Facebook adds to the feed besides ads: "Suggested for you" posts, "People you may know", suggested groups, "Stories you might like", "Pages you may like" and its own upsells. In-feed surveys go too, and so does the "People you may know" row on your own profile. Each kind has its own switch.

patches.name: Hide suggested stories
patches.description: Removes the stories Facebook suggests from people and Pages you don't follow, the ones marked Suggested in the Stories tray. Your friends' stories, the Pages you follow and Create story stay.

patches.name: Hide the Get Messenger card
patches.description: Hides the "Get the Messenger app" card at the top of Chats while Messenger is installed. Facebook only counts a Messenger signed with its own key, so a re-signed Facebook shows the card even with Messenger right there. Without Messenger the card stays.

patches.name: Hide the Reels tab
patches.description: Takes the Reels tab, which some accounts call Video, off the tab bar, and its shortcut out of the long-press menu of Facebook's icon. Reel links and the reels in your feed still open. Facebook's own Hide in its tab bar settings keeps working, and a change to the switch shows once Facebook restarts.

patches.name: Hide the Reels tab dot
patches.description: Takes the new-item dot and count off the Reels tab, which some accounts call Video. Every other tab keeps its own.

patches.name: Hold a reel for 2x
patches.description: Holding a reel plays it at double speed until you let go. The hold takes the place of Facebook's long-press menu, which the reel's more button still opens.

patches.name: Hushfacebook in the Menu
patches.description: Adds a Hushfacebook settings row to Facebook's Menu, at the end of Settings and privacy. The logo long press and the launcher shortcut still open the settings too.

patches.name: Hushfacebook settings
patches.description: Adds Hushfacebook settings to Facebook. Long-press the Facebook logo at the top of your feed, or Facebook's launcher icon, to turn features on or off, pause Hushfacebook, save your switches to a file or load them, and export diagnostics. The licenses are there too.

patches.name: Install beside Meta's apps
patches.description: Lets the official Messenger, Facebook Lite, Business Suite and Workplace install beside the patched Facebook. Facebook shares two permissions with them, and Android lets only one signing key own a permission, so this patch renames Facebook's. A Root Mount install doesn't need it.

patches.name: Keep the reel speed
patches.description: A playback speed you pick in a reel's menu stays for the next reels until you pick another or Facebook restarts.

patches.name: Marketplace only
patches.description: Leaves only Marketplace, Notifications and your profile or Menu in the tab bar, and opens Facebook on Marketplace. Home with the news feed, Video, Friends, Feeds, Groups, Gaming and Events go. Notifications and links still open where they lead. Its switch starts off, so turn it on under Opening Facebook in Hushfacebook's settings.

patches.name: Material You theme
patches.description: Gives Facebook's dark mode the colours of your wallpaper on Android 12 and newer, and a fixed blue palette on Android 11. Light mode stays as it is. Turn on dark mode in Facebook first.

patches.name: Open Messenger from the top bar
patches.description: Lets the Messenger icon at the top of Facebook open the Messenger app instead of Facebook's own Chats. Without Messenger installed, Chats opens as before, and a long press on the icon still does what Facebook does with it. Its switch starts off, so turn it on under Chats in Hushfacebook's settings.

patches.name: Open links in external browser
patches.description: Opens web links in your default browser instead of Facebook's in-app browser, without Facebook's click tracker or the fbclid tag it adds. Facebook pages still open in the app.

patches.name: Open on a chosen tab
patches.description: Opens Facebook on the tab you pick in Hushfacebook's settings when you start it from its icon. It's Marketplace unless you change it. Notifications and links still open where they lead. Its switch starts off, so turn it on under Opening Facebook.

patches.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches.description: Makes profiles and some Settings pages open again on a re-signed build, and lets a Messenger, Messenger Lite or Facebook Lite you patch with this build's own key sign in through it, the same as the real Meta app would. A Root Mount install doesn't need this patch.

patches.name: Resume long videos
patches.description: A video longer than two minutes that you left partway picks up where you left it the next time it plays. Reels, live videos and ads start as usual. Its switch starts off.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Takes Facebook's tracking tags, such as mibextid, off the links you share or copy. The post or reel a link opens stays the same. A facebook.com/share/ link is made for one share, so Facebook can still trace it back to you.

patches.name: Start on x86 devices
patches.description: Keeps Facebook from crashing or freezing as it starts on an x86 device that runs its arm code through a translator, such as an emulator or an x86 Chromebook, by skipping the one start-up step that breaks there. Phones and tablets with arm chips start as before.

patches.name: Stop Story auto-advance
patches.description: Keeps each Story on screen until you tap or swipe. Turn the switch off for Facebook's timing.

patches.name: Stop update prompts
patches.description: Stops Facebook's own update prompts on a patched build, which can't install Meta's updates anyway. Meta App Manager's update promotions and the push message that has it look for an update go, and so do chat promotions aimed at older versions.

patches.name: Tag suggestions only after @
patches.description: Stops Facebook offering people to tag while you type ordinary words in posts and comments. Typing @ still brings up the list. Photo tags and your text aren't touched.

patches.name: Tap to play
patches.description: Videos, reels, stories and music wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves. A tap plays as usual. While its switch is on, Facebook's own Autoplay setting reads Off.

patches.name: Turn off double tap to like
patches.description: Stops a double tap on a reel or a video from liking it, and the heart doesn't show. A single tap still plays or pauses, and the Like button still likes.

patches.name: Use the phone's emoji
patches.description: Draws emoji with your phone's own emoji font instead of Meta's, so the ones in posts, comments and chats look like the ones on your keyboard, big chat emoji included. Reactions and stickers stay as they are. Restart Facebook after changing the switch.

patches.name: Use the system font
patches.description: Draws Facebook's own text in your phone's font instead of Meta's Optimistic typeface, or in a TrueType or OpenType file you pick in Hushfacebook's settings. Icons and emoji keep their fonts, and so does the text you put on a story. Restart Facebook after changing the font.

patches.name: View stories anonymously
patches.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the stories you watch, because Facebook isn't told which ones you've seen. Replying or reacting still shows you, and stories you've watched keep the ring that marks them as new.

release_notes:
Hushfacebook v0.5.0 gathers everything since v0.4.0. It targets Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and still supports 577.0.0.50.72, now with 51 patches, up from 43.

## New patches

- **Hide the Reels tab dot.** No more red dot or number on the Reels tab (called Video on some accounts). Notifications, Marketplace and the other tabs keep their badges. On by default.
- **Hide the Reels tab.** Takes the Reels tab off the tab bar, and its shortcut out of the long-press menu of Facebook's icon. Reel links and reels in your feed still open (#26).
- **Keep the reel speed.** Pick a speed once and the next reels play at it (#25). On by default.
- **Hold a reel for 2x.** Press and hold a playing reel for double speed, let go to go back. Facebook's own pull-down lock works with it.
- **Default playback quality.** Data saver, Up to 480p, Up to 720p or Highest, for reels and videos.
- **Turn off double tap to like.** A double tap on a reel or video no longer likes it. The Like button still does.
- **Open Messenger from the top bar.** The Messenger icon at the top opens the Messenger app instead of Facebook's Chats (#19). In the default selection, with its switch off until you turn it on.
- **View stories anonymously.** Watch stories without being added to their viewer lists (#24).

## Fixes and changes

- **Feed.** The "Suggested for you" row of groups to join is hidden again. Facebook now sends it as one of its own promo cards, so it got past the filter.
- **Marketplace.** Search results lose their ads too, with no gaps left behind (#29).
- **Saves.** Stories and VP9 reels save at full quality with their sound, and a switch makes saves that CapCut and InShot can open.
- **AMOLED and Material You.** Cards turn black on the black page (#27), and the Android 15 bars follow the theme.
- **Messenger.** A Messenger patched with the same Manager key works with your Facebook both ways, including signing in with Continue as.
- **Diagnostic reports** leave out more IDs and tokens, and say why the feed was allowed to refresh.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every change.

## Update

1. Refresh the Hushfacebook source in Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer.
2. Patch the arm64-v8a, Android 11+ bundle of Facebook **580.0.0.51.74**, build **475019344**. Facebook **577.0.0.50.72**, build **474426275**, is also supported.
3. Install over your current patched Facebook using the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key to preserve update compatibility.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook#install).

## Known limitations

Every new patch was tried on a phone, and the changelog says what each check covered. A few fixes were checked with automated tests only, mostly in the diagnostic report and settings. The AI-detected reels filter still hasn't met a reel Facebook has flagged. Some reports still need the reporter's details, including WhatsApp import (#11), Xiaomi Gallery sound (#14), Media settings (#12) and a missing Reel Download button (#18).

Review diagnostic reports before sharing them. The filter can still miss private text it doesn't recognise.

## Validation

Local checks passed: 1327 runtime tests and 565 patch tests with no failures, plus both Android lints and the release-script checks. All 51 patches applied without forcing to both supported Facebook builds, with no resource or injected-code structural errors. The dependency advisory check found no advisory for gson 2.14.0, kotlin-stdlib 2.4.20 or annotations 13.0.
